'''Reading and the Soulbound''' is one of the magic systems of the Willverse.

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The magic system revolves around the connection between humans and powerful entities known as [[Soulbound]]. These individuals borrow powers from beings called [[Elders]] or [[Kameira]], a rarity on the continent. During an [[Awakening]] procedure, a [[Soulbound]] person bonds with a [[Vessel]], which serves as a source of power that can be sealed. [[Vessels]] are entities or internal powers that react to the user's emotions and communicate through impulses, pressure, and impressions rather than speech. Identifying a [[Soulbound]]'s [[Vessel]] is considered a critical task.

A central component of this system is [[Intent]]. This concept involves lending a property to an object, such as wood, copper poles, or doors, which helps the item perform its function more effectively over time. Practitioners can focus their [[Intent]] with extreme precision, similar to a scalpel. One such application is [[Reading]], a technique used to focus the mind on an object, sense a ship, or ensure that a vessel accepts new additions. [[Reading]] can also be used to perceive entities with awareness, such as [[Elderspawn]], though reading the body of a [[Great Elder]] is something to be avoided. However, pushing oneself too far can result in Reader's burn, a condition that can last for months.

Notable entities within this system include the [[Great Elders]]. These beings are powerful enough to blight the weather, and some islands are even haunted by them. While most [[Great Elders]] view themselves as benefactors, a mortal man can be bound to the heart of a [[Great Elder]]. Additionally, [[Elderspawn]] are clawed creatures that may not experience fatigue in the human sense. Some groups, like the [[Sleepless]], seek to communicate with [[Great Elders]] to gain their wisdom, while others have designed specific techniques to combat the spawn of certain [[Great Elders]].}}

<tr class="spoiler-fact" data-book="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow"><td>[[Ach'magut]]</td><td>A dead [[Great Elder]] and mass of appendages sealed beneath [[Silverreach]] that feasts on the collected knowledge of humanity.</td></tr>
